column3: BSB adds “their” and renders “according to godliness” as “that leads to godliness.”
BSB renders “before eternal times” as “before time began.”
BSB follows the critical text: “Grace and peace” and “Christ Jesus,” without the Textus Receptus “mercy” and “Lord.”
BSB adds “An elder must be” for “if anyone is.”
BSB renders “self-willed” as “self-absorbed” and “greedy of base gain” as “greedy for money.”
BSB moves “for the sake of dishonorable gain” forward.
BSB renders “turning away from” as “who have rejected.”
